name: Vapor Chamber
description: The subject stands suspended inside a chamber of drifting cold vapor, dry-ice fog pooling and curling at its base while a single downlight falls straight through the mist. Tall, clinical, and quietly dramatic — the vapor itself is the room, with no walls or floor in sight.
lighting: Single cool downlight, vapor-scattered, no fill
subject: product
prompt: suspended inside a chamber of drifting cold vapor, dry-ice fog pooling and curling low at the base while a single cool downlight falls straight down through the mist, the vapor itself diffusing and scattering the light with no separate fill source, tall vertical negative space rising into near-black haze beyond the light's throw with no visible floor, walls, or machinery, the fog drifting and dissipating unevenly as it catches the light rather than sitting as a uniform CGI mist, true cool blue-white color temperature with no fantasy color grade, natural shallow depth of field from the vapor itself, crisp e-commerce-grade clarity through the mist, no ice crystals, no props beyond the drifting vapor
